summary: Tested consent management feature (GDPR compliance) for RegistraTEAM app. All 13 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing verified consent cards on parent profile page with switches for images_internal and images_promo, athlete consent cards for minor children, and admin consent audit page with entity list and detail modal showing full history.

issues: [Layout children]: No route named 'preseason' exists in nested children

critical_code_review_comments: ConsentManager component properly handles both user and athlete consent types
Admin consent audit page correctly displays entities with consent badges and history count
Detail modal shows full consent state and change history with IP addresses
data-testid attributes are present in code but not rendered in React Native Web DOM (known limitation)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Consent management feature is fully implemented and working. Backend endpoints: GET/PATCH /api/users/me/consents, GET/PATCH /api/athletes/{id}/consents, GET /api/admin/all-consents, GET /api/admin/consent-history/{type}/{id}. Frontend: ConsentManager component renders on parent, coach, and athlete profile pages. Admin settings has 'Consensi Privacy' card linking to /admin/settings/consent-audit page.

backend_api.GET /api/users/me/consents: PASS - Returns user consent data with history

backend_api.GET /api/athletes/{id}/consents: PASS - Returns athlete consent data (parent auth required)
backend_api.PATCH /api/athletes/{id}/consents: PASS - Updates athlete consent (parent auth required)
backend_api.GET /api/admin/all-consents: PASS - Returns list of entities with consents (admin only)
backend_api.GET /api/admin/consent-history/{type}/{i: PASS - Returns full consent detail (admin only)
